segments.label: Segment 1
segments.vo_line: Welcome to Argus, the fraud-defence platform by Credstone. What you're seeing runs on v2.5, with every screen driven by a single API. Getting started costs nothing — the analyst console is $0/month, and a full deployment that watches up to GH¢10,000,000 in daily transactions scales from there. Here's the loop. Open a flagged case, review the linked transactions, and if you misclick, press Ctrl+Z to undo, then Ctrl+S to save your notes. When the evidence is clear, Argus drafts the SAR and hands it to the BoG portal. Detect, investigate, and file — all in one place, without ever leaving the screen.
